name: Bra Size Calculator
author: Md Shariful Islam

sections.description:
Bra Size Calculator for wordpress plugin is a lightweight WordPress plugin that helps users calculate their correct bra size using standard measurement rules commonly used in Bangladesh.

The plugin provides a clean frontend calculator via shortcode and allows basic customization from the WordPress admin panel.

🔹 Key Features

  • Frontend bra size calculator using shortcode
  • Based on Bangladesh standard sizing rules
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Easy to use and beginner friendly
  • Customizable button colors from admin settings
  • No external dependencies

🔹 How It Works

Users enter their measurements, and the calculator instantly displays the appropriate bra size using predefined sizing logic.

🔹 Use Case

Ideal for:
* Fashion websites
* Clothing stores
* Women-focused blogs
* Tailoring or apparel businesses

Usage

Add the following shortcode where you want the calculator to appear:

[brasical_size_calculator]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Bra Size Calculator to configure options
  4. Use the shortcode to display the calculator on any page or post
sections.faq:
Does this plugin store user data?

No. The plugin does not store or track any user data.

Can I customize the calculator button colors?

Yes. Button background and text colors can be customized from the admin settings page.

Is this plugin optimized for performance?

Yes. The plugin is lightweight and loads only required assets.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes. It works with all properly coded WordPress themes.
